::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 8th [1873]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Victoria University of Wellington, NZ
:::

My dear [Mrs Coleridge](people/person_348.qmd)
Alas, I have had so much Tyrol in the Monthly Packet as I am writing to tell [Mrs Prichard](people/person_1893.qmd) I find no series of travels ever answers, people do not keep up their interest - though single papers succeed well.

I hope [Bishop Patteson’s life](cmy_books/cmybook_102.qmd) will be out in a few week’s time.  How soon do you return to Mapledurham for I should like my [‘Cousin Edward’](people/person_332.qmd) as he insists on my calling him to have one of the first copies sent out

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Endorsed in pencil 1873.
